title: Getting out of the Big-Muddy: Escalation of Commitment in LLMs
finding: Peer deliberation escalated far more (99.2%) than individual LLMs; hierarchy 46.2%.
relevance: Closest prior comparison to exp001 — but vignette-based, not agentic.

title: ToolMaze: Dynamic Replanning and Anomaly Recovery in LLM Agents
finding: Single agents over-trust invalid tool paths after anomalies.
relevance: Single-agent persistence baseline; investment not manipulated.

title: Escalating commitment in individual and group decision making
relevance: Human precedent for the single vs multi-agent contrast.

title: The Illusion of Diminishing Returns
finding: Errors in a model's own history raise later errors beyond context-length effects.
relevance: Self-conditioning as a rival to investment — motivates H4.
